accepted_claim: A deterministic tiny LLM-shaped int4 weight fixture exists, and one RTL proxy smoke run uses fixture-derived configuration while preserving CPU-vs-hybrid coverage-output equivalence and measuring hybrid wall speed.
weakest_point_after_review: The first run still does not stream actual tensor bytes through the RTL proxy datapath; it derives scalar configuration from the weight hash. The next step must consume at least selected tensor byte ranges as proxy payload/config data before claiming small-weight serving speed evaluation.

selected_next_gap.reason: Streaming selected tensor bytes into the quantized KV-cache proxy is the smallest step from fixture-derived scalar config toward real weight-consuming RTL evaluation, without jumping directly to a full model graph.
selected_next_gap.expected_scope: select tensor byte ranges from the manifest, map them to proxy configuration or payload stimulus, run CPU and hybrid smoke shapes, and compare coverage outputs

rejected_next_gaps_for_now.gap: download a trained HuggingFace small LLM
rejected_next_gaps_for_now.reason: Would add licensing, size, tokenizer, and model-runtime surface before the RTL proxy can consume even the deterministic local fixture tensors.
Still useful, but larger than the immediate missing link between prepared weights and RTL proxy inputs.
Blocked until a fixture-consuming datapath and token prefill/decode harness exist.

non_claims: not HuggingFace or MLPerf numerical equivalence
not model quality, perplexity, or accuracy
